evidence.quote: Anthropic has introduced Claude Science, a new AI workbench for scientists
evidence.one_line: Anthropic introduced Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientists.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: The beta release, announced June 30, gives Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users access to an application designed to help researchers work across literature review, data analysis, figure generation, manuscript refinement, and computational workflows.
evidence.one_line: Anthropic announced on June 30 that the Claude Science beta would be accessible to Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users for scientific research workflows.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: Anthropic said Claude Science is available on macOS and Linux, and can run locally, on remote machines over SSH, or through a high-performance computing login node.
evidence.one_line: Anthropic said Claude Science is available on macOS and Linux and can run locally, over SSH on remote machines, or through an HPC login node.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: Users interact with a generalist coordinating agent that has access to more than 60 curated skills and connectors configured for genomics, single-cell analysis, proteomics, structural biology, cheminformatics, and other research areas.
evidence.one_line: Anthropic said Claude Science's coordinating agent has access to more than 60 curated scientific skills and connectors.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: The system can also use specialist agents created by users, and includes a reviewer agent that checks citations and calculations, flagging and correcting errors, according to Anthropic.
evidence.one_line: Anthropic said Claude Science can use user-created specialist agents and includes a reviewer agent that checks citations and calculations and flags and corrects errors.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: When Claude Science generates a figure, it includes the code and environment used to create it, a plain-language description of the process, and the message history leading up to the output.
evidence.one_line: Anthropic said Claude Science figures include the generating code and environment, a process description, and the preceding message history.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: NVIDIA's role comes through its BioNeMo Agent Toolkit, which the chipmaker announced June 23.
evidence.one_line: NVIDIA announced its BioNeMo Agent Toolkit on June 23.
evidence.speaker: NVIDIA, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: Anthropic said Claude Science uses BioNeMo Agent Toolkit skills to connect to life sciences models and libraries in BioNeMo, including Evo 2, Boltz-2, and OpenFold3.
evidence.one_line: Anthropic said Claude Science uses BioNeMo Agent Toolkit skills to connect to BioNeMo life-sciences models and libraries, including Evo 2, Boltz-2, and OpenFold3.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: NVIDIA describes BioNeMo Agent Toolkit as a set of domain-specific tools and skills for agentic life sciences workflows.
evidence.one_line: NVIDIA described BioNeMo Agent Toolkit as domain-specific tools and skills for agentic life-sciences workflows.
evidence.speaker: NVIDIA, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: The toolkit includes NVIDIA life sciences libraries, tools, and open models, and is designed to help agents gather evidence, reason across findings, run computational experiments, and recommend next steps.
evidence.one_line: NVIDIA said BioNeMo Agent Toolkit includes its life-sciences libraries, tools, and open models and is designed to support agentic research tasks.
evidence.speaker: NVIDIA, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: OpenAI has announced it is preparing to retire Custom GPTs and move the specialized workflows built around them to a new plugin architecture spanning ChatGPT and its Codex coding agent.
evidence.one_line: OpenAI announced plans to retire Custom GPTs and move their specialized workflows to a plugin architecture across ChatGPT and Codex.
evidence.speaker: OpenAI, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: Meta is returning to open-weight artificial intelligence with Muse Glimmer, a new AI model designed to run on consumer hardware, as CEO Mark Zuckerberg argues that increasingly capable AI should be widely available rather than controlled by a small number of institutions.
evidence.one_line: Meta introduced Muse Glimmer, an open-weight AI model designed to run on consumer hardware.
evidence.speaker: Meta, as reported by the article

evidence.quote: Microsoft has unveiled Frontier Company, making a $2.5 billion bet that the next competitive battleground in artificial intelligence will not be foundation models, but helping enterprises put those models to work.
evidence.one_line: Microsoft unveiled Frontier Company and described it as a $2.5 billion investment in helping enterprises deploy AI models.
evidence.speaker: Microsoft, as reported by the article
